title: Redacted FBI files on Silas Newton and GeBauer

tellings.quote:
And then you have these FBI files
on Silus Newton and Gabau going way back
to the uh I think the 30s or something
and they're they're totally redacted.

plain: The FBI kept files on two men, Silas Newton and Leo GeBauer, going back, Jesse Michels thinks, to 'the 30s or something,' and those files are 'totally redacted,' meaning blacked out. Michels says this himself on the show without giving more detail, as a sign that the bureau was hiding something about the pair.
